findings.issue_summary: Data Safety Compliant (Local-Only): false positive text and UI geometry matches
findings.evidence: runtime_strings.xml:3 and drive_backup_strings.xml:17 contain Indonesian kosong, meaning empty; song is only a substring. DocumentLayoutSizeVisuals.kt:36 and :74 refer to a visual slider track. No music file source or transfer is present.
findings.recommendation: Do not declare music based on these matches.

findings.purpose: App functionality: optional manual and scheduled cloud backup/restore; user-initiated PDF export/sharing
findings.issue_summary: Background Transfer (Disclosure Claimed): optional Google Drive PDF backup; explicit sharing also present
findings.evidence: DocumentToolsHandler.kt:57-62 and :78 and PdfImportHandler.kt:48-60 and :69 only import user-selected PDFs. DocumentActionsViewModel.kt:200 and :463-469 explicitly trigger share; DocumentActionsHandler.kt:75-85 sends a PDF URI/title to the Android chooser, a user-initiated sharing path. Separately GoogleDriveBackupRemote.kt:65-131 writes ZIP metadata and archive bytes via HTTPS upload endpoint at :402. AutomaticBackupRunner.kt:46-48 requires automaticEnabled, an authorized account, and later Premium entitlement before creating and uploading a backup at :100-108. AndroidBackupSettingsRepository.kt:49 defaults automaticEnabled to false; WorkManagerBackupScheduler.kt:24-34 gates scheduling on opt-in. DriveBackupScreen.kt:649-654 exposes the Backup automático switch; DriveBackupViewModel.kt:509-523 saves that choice before scheduling. Visible backup intro says 'Guarde seus PDFs no Drive e leve com você.'; backup scope text explains only saved PDFs, and background status explains continued operation after leaving the screen. This supports opt-in disclosed background backup, not a proven policy violation.
findings.recommendation: Treat files/documents as optional collection for Google Drive backup/app functionality unless a specific applicable exception is confirmed. User-triggered Android share-sheet transfers can use the user-initiated sharing exception. Confirm the release's Data Safety answers include scheduled Drive uploads and do not describe the app as wholly local-only.
